_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Doe bès Speler {player_id} in 't spel LinesOfAction.
Diene sjievele zeen '{side}', de sjievele van diene taegesjtander zeen '{other}'.
Verplaatsingsformaat: `[b1b3]` (van-coördinaat nao coördinaat). 'ne Geldige zet geit horizontaal, verticaal of diagonaal 'n aontal veldere geliek aan 't totaal aontal sjievele (in eder kleur) op die lien. Doe maogs euver eige sjievele sjpringe, mer neet euver sjievele van diene taegesjtander; lanje op 'ne sjievel van diene taegesjtander pak 'm. Wins wen al diene sjievele 8-naober verbónge zeen.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: De beweging mót rech of diagonaal zien.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Moot 'n aafstand bewaege geliek aan 't aantal stökke in de lien.
